video_title: Inside Keyonte George’s Contract Extension with Austin Ainge 🔑

quotes.speaker: Austin Ainge
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Ainge on Keyonte George's growth and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: We've seen so much growth as a person and a player.
quotes.quote: We are so proud of Keyonte George. He's worked so hard and we've seen so much growth as a person and a player. He's been completely bought in to our program. He's been a great leader, he's been a great teammate, he's been coachable, we've coached him hard. Will Hardy has pushed him and he's responded. We are thrilled, and he enjoys it here as well, and so we were able to work together and find a deal that was fair.

quotes.speaker: Austin Ainge
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Ainge on Keyonte George's leadership style
quotes.excerpt: He's a really happy, nice person. He gets along with everybody and he shows up for everybody.
quotes.quote: Leadership is different. Sometimes we have a narrow definition, and Keyonte George is a really happy, nice person. He gets along with everybody and he shows up for everybody. He's maybe not a screamer and a yeller type of guy, he's not a taskmaster, he's still very young learning his own way in the league, but he shows up for everybody, he is there for everybody, he is smile and work ethic every day. That's his way of leading and that's awesome.

quotes.speaker: Austin Ainge
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Ainge on Keyonte George's presence in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The NBA is a hard place and there's a lot of, 'Oh, here's this rookie, is he going to take my shots?'
quotes.quote: The NBA is a hard place and there's a lot of, 'Oh, here's this rookie, is he going to take my shots?' And Keyonte George just, he's just there front row saying, 'I'm here with you, let's go win games,' and we really appreciate that stuff.

quotes.speaker: Austin Ainge
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Ainge on the potential of the Utah Jazz backcourt
quotes.excerpt: The NBA is about depth. You need a lot of guys and you need different types of abilities.
quotes.quote: They are just good guys and they are both really talented. Honestly, they can both play on and off the ball, and they have good size for their position. We are hopeful that it can be great along with a lot of other talented guys. Obviously, Lauri Markkanen and Walker Kessler and Brice Sensabaugh and Svi Mykhailiuk and Isaiah Collier and the two Josh's we've added. We've got a lot of guys, and that's what we believe the NBA is now. It is about depth. You need a lot of guys and you need different types of abilities and different types of leadership.

quotes.speaker: Austin Ainge
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Ainge on Keyonte George's relationship with Will Hardy
quotes.excerpt: Keyonte George comes to Will Hardy for real life challenges and basketball things.
quotes.quote: They are very close and Keyonte George comes to Will Hardy for real life challenges and basketball things, and Will Hardy will give it to him straight and Keyonte knows that. We've just tried to all show that we care about him as more than a player. You never know how basketball works out but we're here and we're a family and we try to get better and we try to help him and he's embraced that through ups and downs.

quotes.speaker: Austin Ainge
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Ainge on the reality of NBA development
quotes.excerpt: It's not just given right away. It's hard. It's a hard league. It's a hard transition.
quotes.quote: It's helpful for a lot of guys that are coming into the league to just see that it's not just given right away. It's hard. It's a hard league. It's a hard transition and everything doesn't just happen on day one. It's a grind and every player has their own journey and path and not all will be like Keyonte George's, but I think it'll be helpful for him to explain how things were hard for him and he got taken out of starting lineups and in and out of rotations and different roles until he could establish himself.
